motions.name: 轻踢换重 · 右
motions.reviewNotes: 0.5.1 anatomy correction: bounded authored upper-body curves and relaxed finger channels. Both characters passed 120 Hz full-clip normalized range and signed elbow/knee/finger bend checks. Actual DancePlayback passed all 20 retained directed connections on both characters. Visually inspected all 40 selected six-frame connection boards and 16 worst-range body frames. Retains CMU subject 93 Charleston step patterns with cycle editing, smoothing and authored arm counter-swing; four cuts plus four mirrored variants. Technical and rendered-frame review, not dance-teacher certification and not New Jazz. See Docs/ANATOMY_051_VERIFICATION.md.
